create_wecom_channel: create a WeComChannel instance configured with a message bus and bot credentials for WeCom integration
start_wecom_channel: start the WeComChannel to establish a WebSocket connection and begin receiving messages from WeCom
send_wecom_message: send an outbound markdown message or streamed reply to a WeCom user via the WeComChannel
upload_wecom_file: upload an image or file attachment to WeCom using chunked WebSocket media upload with MD5 verification
stop_wecom_channel: stop the WeComChannel by disconnecting the WebSocket client and cleaning up all active session state
